evidence.detail: Link styling uses a complex set of selectors with text-decoration: none on hover/focus, affecting a.force-link-style, calendar links, intro details, and li links differently
text-decoration: none set globally; varied per-context overrides make the link style context-dependent and inconsistent

triage.notes: This requires a product/design decision on what the canonical link style should be, then broad visual regression testing across many page types. Likely >150 CSS selector changes and manual QA.
